```{r}
gs_lst <-msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus",
                 collection = "H",
                 subcollection = NULL) %>%
    with(.,split(gene_symbol, gs_name))

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::AddModuleScore(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,gs_lst["HALLMARK_P53_PATHWAY"])

```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,c("Cluster1"), order = TRUE,split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", limit = c(0,0.35))&RestoreLegend()
```

```{r}
Idents(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5"
VlnPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = "Cluster1",group.by = "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5",sort = TRUE)
VlnPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = "Cluster1",group.by = "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5",sort = TRUE, idents = c("5", "21", "2"))
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = "Cluster1",group.by = "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5",sort = TRUE, idents = c("5", "21", "2"),split.by = "sample.name")
```

```{r}
Idents(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5"
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::FindSubCluster(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,cluster = "5",graph.name = "sNN_pca.SCT_30",resolution = 0.2)
```

```{r}
Idents(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "sub.cluster"

VlnPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = "Cluster1",group.by = "sub.cluster",sort = TRUE, idents = c("5_0","5_1","5_2", "21", "2"))
```
